Frequently asked questions

What is today's Hijri date?

Today's Hijri date is shown in the box at the top of the home page. It follows the Saudi (Umm al-Qura) calendar, so it can differ by a day from moon sighting in your country; use the adjustment option to match it.

Are these tools free?

Yes, every tool is free and you do not need an account.

Is my data saved?

What you type into the tools is used inside your browser and is not stored on our servers. Details are in the privacy policy.

Are the horoscope and fortune readings real?

No, they are for fun only. Please do not base any decision on them.

Can I message a number on WhatsApp without saving it?

Yes. In the WhatsApp direct tool, choose the country code, type the number and open the chat.
